name: zk-access-gate
description: ZK Access Gate monorepo (P3: gateway, protected services, demo UI, SSO baseline)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.bench: npm run build -w shared && npm run bench -w bench
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n svc,gw,p2,sso,ui -c gray,cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w services" "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w integration/p2-standin" "npm run dev -w baseline/sso-gateway" "npm run dev -w ui"
